question.prompt: The graphs of the inverse proportional function \(y=k/x\) and the linear function \(y=x+1\) intersect at \(A(2,m)\). Find the values of \(m\) and \(k\), in that order, separated by a comma.

solutions.explanation: A lies on \(y=x+1\), so \(m=2+1=3\). Also, \(A(2,3)\) lies on \(y=k/x\), so \(k=2\times3=6\).
solutions.title: Substitute the common point
